entries.zh: 姘居；私通（未成婚而居处如夫妇）
entries.en: to cohabit, to live together as man and wife without marriage; to enter into concubinage

entries.zh: 与之相好；和某人姘居
entries.en: to be intimate with someone; to cohabit with him or her

entries.zh: 割不断；难分难舍（同居日久，拆不散）
entries.en: inseparable, impossible to cut apart (of a couple long cohabiting)
entries.notes: L栏『aman cebados juntos los cantiguen no se apartien』经校正为『…que no se aparten』；H『割不断』与R对音互证。

entries.zh: 长年姘居；相欠债（俗谓前世相欠、久结不解）
entries.en: long-standing concubinage (folk idiom: 'mutually owed debt' that binds the pair)
entries.notes: H『相欠债』为闽南俗语（前世相欠），与L『de muchos tiempos』相合，义据俗语推定。

entries.zh: 契家（姘妇、外室）；做龟公靠女人过活
entries.en: kept mistress, concubine; (of a man) living off a woman, a pimp
entries.notes: L栏『abarraganad, como el rufi que gana dello』后半指靠女人过活者；H『契家』指外室，R对音畸变。

entries.zh: 立意不散、刻意不分离（同居已惯）
entries.en: deliberately inseparable, resolved not to part
entries.notes: H『熟骨』非经见词，语义难定；仅据L『de propósito que no se separan』推为立意不散。

entries.zh: 熟查某（惯熟的相好女子）；与女子姘居
entries.en: to cohabit with a woman; a habitual kept woman
entries.notes: H末字封存件作『么』，据M『boêi』与R『mòn』判为『某』，即『熟查某』（查某＝女子）。

entries.zh: 嫖娼；娼妓之事（姘居、卖淫）
entries.en: whoring, prostitution; illicit concubinage
entries.notes: M第二字T99污损，H二字与R『hiān siān』对音不协；据L『putería』暂定嫖娼之义。

entries.zh: 黎明；破晓
entries.en: dawn, daybreak

entries.zh: 怜惜；疼爱
entries.en: to cherish, to feel tenderly toward
entries.notes: L仅存缩写『A Mar.』（amar）；M栏多出『gelan』（疑为『人』lâng），H/R无对应。

entries.zh: 惜福；爱惜福分（引申为节俭、不奢费）
entries.en: to cherish one's blessings; to be frugal, sparing of one's substance
entries.notes: L『amar su fuente』与H『惜福』不协，疑原文为『su hazienda』一类；释义从H及R对音。

entries.zh: 惜命；贪生（爱惜性命）
entries.en: to cling to life, to be sparing of one's own life
entries.notes: M第二字T99污损；H『惜死』、R『zǐ』、L『amar la vida』三者互证。

entries.zh: 爱惜性命；惜身
entries.en: to cherish one's life
entries.notes: M第二字T99污损；H『惜性命』与R『sīng mēng』一致。

entries.zh: 相惜；彼此爱惜
entries.en: to cherish one another; mutual affection
entries.notes: L作『amar seruos arbos』，疑为『amar se unos a otros』之讹；H『相惜』与R『chiǎng sīg』定其义。

entries.zh: 爱；喜爱
entries.en: to love, to like

entries.zh: 爱慕；倾心爱恋
entries.en: to adore, to be enamored of
entries.notes: H『暮』依封存件[疑]读作『慕』，作『爱慕』。

entries.zh: 爱好；喜欢
entries.en: to be fond of, to like
entries.notes: L作括注『(Amar.)』，疑为同义补录或参见；H『好』作动词读 hào。

entries.zh: 好色；贪恋女色
entries.en: to be lustful, to lust after women

entries.zh: 宠爱（下属）；偏爱
entries.en: to favor, to dote on a subordinate
entries.notes: H栏字形作『罷』，与R『chòng』及L『amar al inferior…』不合，判为『寵』之形讹。

entries.zh: 宠爱；因德行而偏爱某人
entries.en: to dote on, to show special favor (for someone's virtues)
entries.notes: H栏『罷』为『寵』之形讹（R『chòng』、L义为宠爱）；M首字T99污损。

entries.zh: 宠幸；格外偏爱（虽恶亦爱）
entries.en: to favor greatly, to dote on even an unworthy inferior
entries.notes: H栏『罷倖』当为『寵倖』，R『chòng hēng』可证；M首字T99污损。

entries.zh: 恩宠赏赐；君王宠爱赏赉
entries.en: royal favor and reward; to bestow favor and gifts
entries.notes: H栏『罷賜』当为『寵賜』，R『chòng zū』与L『premiar el Rey』可证；M首字T99污损。
